meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the submission time is extended
gaps: Open the QA mailboxes of the concerned vendors and verify that each receives exactly one email announcing the new end time.
Verify that no other vendor receives the email and that no real supplier receives it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA mailboxes of the concerned vendors and verify that each receives exactly one email announcing the new end time.; Verify that no other vendor receives the email and that no real supplier receives it.

steps.note: Create a test event for the email trigger.
Use an RFQ stage so its submission time can be extended.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Invite two QA vendors so recipient inclusion and exclusion can be checked externally.
Publish the event before extending its submission time.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Trigger the submission-time extension that should generate vendor email notifications.
Confirm the extension action completed without an application error.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes of the concerned and other vendors and verify exactly one new-end-time email per concerned vendor, none for other vendors, and none for real suppliers

steps.note: Mailbox access and email recipient verification are not available through the catalog.
Keep a terminal assertion after the tester intervention.
